Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of JPM.
We delivered record revenue of $23.6 billion this quarter, representing 13% year-over-year growth.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 102 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2022.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $0.65 per share.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 151 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 13% to 23% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
